evidence.api_compatibility: The llamacpp_backend parameter in the POST /v1/models load endpoint now accepts 'halobox' as a new value (docs/api/lemonade.md, src/cpp/server/routes/lemonade/load/load.cpp). This is purely additive — existing API calls with other values are unaffected. No breaking changes.
evidence.documentation: README.md updated with the halobox row in the GPU support table (llamacpp section now has 8 variants, up from 7). docs/api/lemonade.md updated with halobox in the llamacpp_backend enum. docs/dev/backends-reference.md updated in both the backend tier table and the backend details table. docs/guide/configuration/container-backends.md lists the halobox image link. docs/guide/configuration/llamacpp.md has a dedicated halobox subsection with platform, hardware, use case, installation, and enable instructions. RFC #3585 was approved per the PR checklist.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The halobox container backend is a new user-reachable surface (installable via `lemonade backends install llamacpp:halobox` or loadable via `--backend halobox`). It targets Strix Halo (gfx1151) hardware specifically, which is a narrow audience. CI coverage (test-container-backends job) and local testing by the author and @sawansri provide reasonable confidence. The backend follows the same pattern as llamacpp:nathanw (guest tier, container, pinned image). No separate manual release test item required at this time.
evidence.post_approval_commits: None. No commits were added after the first approval (2026-11-03T15:24:54Z) or the latest approval (2026-11-03T19:19:41Z). The branch was stable at merge time.
evidence.review: Two approvals: @sawansri (expertise: agents, tui, cli, new backends) gave an e2e approval confirming the halobox container works well, and @pwilkin (expertise: Trellis, OpenMOSS, ACE-Step, ThinkSound, llamacpp) approved with 'LGTM'. No inline review comments. The PR had frequent revisions ('constantly on the move' per @pwilkin) but no commits were added after the first or latest approval, so no post-approval churn to flag. @pwilkin's llamacpp subject-matter expertise is particularly relevant here.
evidence.security: The container image is from the same registry as other guest backends (kyuz0/amd-strix-halo-toolboxes), pinned by digest. It maps /dev/dri and /dev/kfd devices, consistent with other ROCm container backends. No new credential handling, network calls, or code execution paths beyond what existing container backends already do. No concerns.
evidence.tests: The halobox backend was added to the test-container-backends CI matrix in cpp_server_build_test_release.yml (install: llamacpp:halobox, extra_args: --wrapped-server llamacpp --backend halobox). The PR author reports 32 local tests passing with Docker (3 skipped, same as every llamacpp backend). Test utilities updated in test/utils/capabilities.py. Benchmarks provided in the PR comparing halobox against nathanw, rocm, and vulkan for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP and Qwen3.8-27B models.

subject: feat(llamacpp): add the halobox container backend (#4029)
summary: Adds llamacpp:halobox, a guest container backend that runs the halo-box/strix-llama.cpp community fork of llama.cpp (ROCm) from the kyuz0/amd-strix-halo-toolboxes image (sha256:7d3844524fda1865a2ae60cc73eb232589626ccca245cc3c7bd2afb153bd9bd6), adding Strix Halo (gfx1151) GPU support with 2048-token batch defaults.
verdict_reason: Small, well-scoped new backend addition with two approvals from reviewers with relevant expertise (llamacpp and new backends), CI matrix coverage, and complete documentation updates.
